outgoing.name: England
outgoing.excerpt: John Flamsteed, ( 19 August 1646 - 31 December 1719) was an English astronomer.

outgoing.name: Planet
outgoing.excerpt: He was responsible for several of the earliest recorded sightings of the planet Uranus, which he mistook for a star and catalogued as 34 Tauri.

outgoing.name: Solar eclipse
outgoing.excerpt: Flamsteed accurately calculated the solar eclipses of 1666 and 1668.
